runs.note: First plan: circular-buffer model, random traffic, boundary coverage.
Model fix: push/pop decided on the state before the edge (spec: no bypass when full).

summary: Reference model of a FWFT FIFO (spec-level: circular buffer, count, no-bypass rule), random back-pressure on both sides, 7 boundary coverage points (including simultaneous read/write at 1, 7 and full). The first plan's model was wrong (it allowed a bypass write); the spec decided it, and the DUT was right.
